description: This file implements UE (User Equipment) capability management for 5G NR, including decoding UE capabilities, configuring MCS tables, HARQ parameters, and handling UE creation/removal. It interacts with ASN.1 encoded data, manages UE feature sets, and supports advanced NR features like NTN.

classes.name: ue_capability_manager
classes.description: Manages UE capabilities, including decoding, configuration, and updates based on ASN.1 data and test modes.

methods.name: decode_ue_nr_cap_container
methods.description: Decodes a UE NR capability container from ASN.1 data into a summary structure.

methods.name: decode_advanced_ue_nr_ntn_caps
methods.description: Placeholder for decoding advanced NTN capabilities (not implemented).

methods.name: set_pdsch_mcs_table
methods.description: Configures the PDSCH MCS table in the serving cell configuration.

methods.name: set_pusch_mcs_table
methods.description: Configures the PUSCH MCS table in the serving cell configuration.

methods.name: set_ul_mimo
methods.description: Sets UL MIMO parameters such as max rank and SRS ports.

methods.name: set_pdsch_interleaving
methods.description: Sets VRB-to-PRB interleaving for PDSCH.

methods.name: set_max_dl_nof_harqs
methods.description: Sets maximum number of DL HARQ processes.

methods.name: set_max_ul_nof_harqs
methods.description: Sets maximum number of UL HARQ processes.

methods.name: set_dl_dci_harq_num_field_size
methods.description: Configures HARQ process number size for DL DCI.

methods.name: set_ul_dci_harq_num_field_size
methods.description: Configures HARQ process number size for UL DCI.

methods.name: set_ul_harq_mode
methods.description: Sets UL HARQ mode mask.

methods.name: set_dl_harq_feedback_disabled
methods.description: Configures DL HARQ feedback disabled mask.

methods.name: select_pdsch_mcs_table
methods.description: Selects appropriate PDSCH MCS table based on UE capabilities and configuration.

methods.name: select_pusch_mcs_table
methods.description: Selects appropriate PUSCH MCS table based on UE capabilities and configuration.

methods.name: select_pdsch_interleaving
methods.description: Selects PDSCH interleaving type based on UE capabilities.

methods.name: select_tx_codebook_subset
methods.description: Selects UL transmission codebook subset based on UE capabilities.

methods.name: select_srs_nof_ports
methods.description: Selects number of SRS ports supported by UE.

methods.name: select_pusch_max_rank
methods.description: Selects maximum PUSCH rank supported by UE.

methods.name: select_max_dl_nof_harqs
methods.description: Selects maximum DL HARQ processes supported by UE.

methods.name: select_max_ul_nof_harqs
methods.description: Selects maximum UL HARQ processes supported by UE.

methods.name: select_dl_dci_harq_num_field_size
methods.description: Selects HARQ size for DL DCI based on UE capabilities.

methods.name: select_ul_dci_harq_num_field_size
methods.description: Selects HARQ size for UL DCI based on UE capabilities.

methods.name: select_disabled_dl_harq_feedback
methods.description: Determines DL HARQ feedback disable mask based on capabilities.

methods.name: select_ul_harq_mode
methods.description: Determines UL HARQ mode mask based on capabilities.

methods.name: update_drx
methods.description: Updates DRX configuration based on UE capabilities.
